node.title: PMA two-full-petal contributors are coprime-pair linear slices
node.statement: For pairwise-coprime monic petal locators L_1,L_2 of degree ell, distinct labels c_1,c_2, and d=ell+s with 0<=s<ell, the space of pairs (F,W) of degree at most d satisfying L_i|(W-c_iF) is linearly isomorphic to pairs (A_1,A_2) of degree at most s by F=(L_1A_1-L_2A_2)/(c_2-c_1) and W=c_1F+L_1A_1. Its dimension is exactly 2s+2 and its image in the locator space has codimension ell-s-1. If F is disjoint from the petals, gcd(F,W)=1 iff gcd(A_1,A_2)=1. Every M=4,t=2 FPC5 contributor injects into this petal-equation envelope, but an exact PMA cell additionally imposes its background-root, exactness, and first-owner guards.
